column2: evening makeup: smoky plum-brown eyeshadow, thicker winged eyeliner, longer lashes, deep wine-red matte lips, a soft contour.
bright party makeup: vivid pink-violet eyeshadow, glossy hot-pink lips, rosy blush on the cheeks.
classic glamour makeup: sharp black winged eyeliner, golden shimmer eyeshadow, glossy classic red lips.
soft natural makeup: warm peach blush on the cheeks, light brown mascara, a little soft brown shading in the eye crease, glossy nude-pink lips.
graphic cat-eye makeup: a sharp thick black winged eyeliner extended out to the temples, black mascara, no coloured eyeshadow, soft nude matte lips.
Y2K makeup: frosty icy-blue shimmer eyeshadow on the lids, thin silver liner, a few tiny sparkling rhinestones under the outer corners of the eyes, glossy baby-pink lip gloss.
peachy makeup: warm peach-coral eyeshadow, coral blush high on the cheeks, satin coral lips.
goth makeup: heavy black smoky eyeshadow all around the eyes, thick black liner, dark burgundy almost black matte lips.
